verdict.rationale: Community Phone's business Team plan lists a 'Dial menu' and 'Advanced call routing', and the business page says you can 'route every call to the right person', so the product appears to ship a phone menu with routing. These are only one-line feature-list mentions, with no documentation of how menu options map to teams or groups. missing for 10: documentation of configuring menu options (e.g. press 1 for sales), mapping options to team ring groups, setup steps or screenshots, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can build a phone menu (press 1 for sales) that routes callers to teams

citations.quote: Share your business number with your team. Dial menu. Live transfer
Set up call routing and call forwarding
route every call to the right person
Incoming calls can ring multiple numbers at once, or roll to different numbers if the first one isn’t answered
